verdict.rationale: Increase's REST API and List Events endpoint let customers programmatically pull their transaction/account data in JSON (an open format) rather than being locked into a dashboard-only view, which is a thin form of data accessibility. However there is no documentation of a bulk 'export all data' feature, account-closure/data-portability process, or explicit commitment to letting customers leave with their full data. Missing for 10: dedicated data-export/portability documentation, account closure/migration guidance, evidence of full historical data dump capability.
